stemMd: A trader converts 600 euros at 1.10 dollars per euro and pays a 2% fee on the dollar amount received. How many dollars remain?
explanationMd: The conversion yields 660 dollars. Keeping 98% gives 646.80 dollars. The fee is denominated as a proportion of the converted amount.

distractorRationale.a: Applies the fee to euros but never converts.
distractorRationale.c: Subtracts 12 dollars, treating the euro-based fee as dollars.
